grammar-de-intj-hallo-greeting.explanation: The prompt treats ordinary sentence-initial capitalization as Standard, requires ordinary casing to be normalized, and demonstrates Ja normalizing to ja; the model nevertheless preserved the capital H only in normalizedSurface.

grammar-de-intj-typo-huraa.explanation: The prompt explicitly limits licensed lengthening to spellings that preserve the canonical character sequence and classifies deletion, transposition, or substitution as Typo; the model nevertheless treated huraa as Standard instead of classifying and repairing the spelling error.

grammar-de-intj-unresolved-nominalized-a.explanation: The prompt explicitly excludes a marked form used as a noun under a possessive or adjective; despite both Sein and ständiges marking Ach as nominalized here, the model resolved it as INTJ.
